level5_names.convention: name (evidence gate = best source-substitution recovered fraction of the mean-ablation floor); attention gates are weak by construction (context is their job) except attn2
level5_names.mlp5: mid-stack token-identity feature table, the deep operand store (floor +0.588, the largest; token-mean table recovers 0.97; broadcast to blocks 6-10 within the window)
level5_names.mlp4: bracket/currency/date token table for measurement-and-price contexts (top inputs " [", " $", " (", " £", month names; token table recovers 0.93)
level5_names.mlp3: list/heading continuation table (fires on "-", headers, proper-noun starts; pushes title-case sentence starts; token table 0.94)
level5_names.mlp2: small-count/quantifier token table (" three", " two", " four", " all", " five"; token table 0.96)
level5_names.mlp0: linear token feature table (linear-in-embedding substitution 0.88 beats the token-mean 0.79; small floor +0.034)
level5_names.mlp6: main next-token syntax engine at the readout (readout consumes 1.34 nats, the largest edge; pushes newline/connective/punctuation continuations; token table 0.87; monolith uninspected inside)
level5_names.mlp10: common-verb continuation smoother (pushes " think/know/feel/find" after auxiliary/complement contexts; readout 0.86 nats; token table 0.73)
level5_names.mlp8: function-word smoothing toward articles/prepositions (PC1 minus-side " the/in/a/to"; token table 0.83)
level5_names.mlp7: clause-continuation table around discourse verbs (" picked", "What", " disagree"; pushes " not/then/also"; token table 0.87)
level5_names.mlp9: narrative pronoun-context module at the readout (she/her scenes; token table 0.62, a third unaccounted)
level5_names.mlp11: readout-only particle promoter (" up/around/off/onto"; token table 0.41, HALF UNNAMED)
level5_names.attn2: apostrophe-contraction completer (inputs t/ll/ve/s/re/m/d after apostrophes, pushes "'m/'ve/to"; 81% TOKEN-SUBSTITUTABLE, the one crisply nameable attention module)
level5_names.attn9: physical-substance/recipe topic carrier (pushes " water/skin/heat/food" in cooking/biology contexts; gate 0.18)
level5_names.attn8: she/her pronoun-context + bullet-list carrier (two features one module, resists a single name; gate 0.17; the same she/her+mixed-script pairing seen in V8 a8)
level5_names.attn7: second-person address promoter + Cyrillic-script carrier (pushes " you/your/yourself"; gate 0.26)
level5_names.attn0: diffuse early contextual carrier, no crisp type (gate 0.46 linear)
level5_names.attn3: diffuse mid contextual carrier, no crisp type (gate 0.27)
level5_names.dead_modules: attn1, mlp1, attn4, attn5 (source-ablation floors <= 0.0000; block 1 causally dead as a whole)
